title: Explorer navigation bar
responsibility: Provides repository, category, revision and scoped entity navigation.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.base
inputs.description: Required explorer mount address. Used for the brand link before a branch is resolved and as the fallback search link.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.repository
inputs.description: Required repository label or null. A missing or empty label hides the repository name.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.scope
inputs.description: Required current explorer location and revision context, or null while unresolved. Null disables category navigation and hides revision controls and search.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.index
inputs.description: Required repository index or null. Revision selectors appear only when a scope and index are available.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.commits
inputs.description: Required branch revision choices in newest-first order. The viewed revision is added if absent from this list.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.href
inputs.description: Required function producing a complete address, including the mount, for a location.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.onroute
inputs.description: Required callback for ordinary navigation clicks and revision or search selections. Modified links retain normal browser behavior.

inputs.name: HarnessNavbar.search
inputs.description: Optional searchable entities for the viewed revision, or null entries while loading. The search helper excludes entries for a mismatched revision.

outputs.name: HarnessNavbar
outputs.description: Five scoped primary destinations with shared module-category tabs inside Modules, revision controls and entity search. Unresolved navigation is disabled. Plain clicks route inside the host; modified clicks retain their normal link behavior.
